experiment: After the 2026-11-22 flop (reach 1, broad hashtags did not lift reach): new hook type (time-loss instead of truth-callout/cost metaphor), CTA changed from save to send-to-someone because saves stayed at 0, two-thirds of hashtags kept, three rotated. Photo style, 7 slides and ~22:00 IST unchanged.

slides.text: Your [[someday]] is running out of days.
Planning feels like progress. The calendar [[disagrees]].
Time is the one [[currency]] you cannot earn back.
Habits are quiet [[chains]]. Forge yours on purpose.
The bar does not care how you [[feel]].
Decide now. [[Send]] this to someone who keeps saying someday.
